name: Respecting Your Elders
overview: Scripture commands honoring and respecting elders as a reflection of reverence for God, promising blessings for those who honor their parents and the aged (Exodus 20:12; Leviticus 19:32). The wisdom and understanding that come with age are to be valued, as the elderly possess insight gained through long life (Job 12:12; Proverbs 19:20). The beauty of old age is portrayed as honorable and glorious, contrasting with the strength of youth, emphasizing the dignity of the aged (Proverbs 20:29). While recognizing human frailty and the reality of offenses, believers are called to uphold respect toward elders as a godly principle (Luke 17:1).
